Mimosas in one hand, coronas in the other 👑🥂 Drag Brunch de Reinas is touching down this summer and honey, it's a whole production — four queens, zero melting faces, puro fuego from doors to last sip. Doors open 9:30am, VIP gets the queens up close 10-11am before brunch even starts, then the show hits 11am-1pm followed by photos and a day party that keeps the party going till 4pm. Esto no es un brunch cualquiera — es un evento completo. Grab VIP, grab your girls, and get there early porque las mesas se llenan rápido. Set that alarm, Pasco — the queens are already picking their looks. 💋✨

Picture it: sunlight bouncing off mimosa flutes, glitter catching the morning light, y cuatro reinas sirviendo look tras look sin sudar ni una gota 💫 Drag Brunch de Reinas is that Saturday morning energy you didn't know you needed — laughter bouncing off the walls, mischief in the air, brunch plates clinking next to champagne toasts. You feel the room shift when the show starts at 11, everybody leaning in, gritando, viviendo el momento. By the time the day party rolls in at 2, you're floating on bubbles and good vibes. Es una vibra que se siente completa, from the first sip to the last song. 🥂🎶

No fancy brunch outfit required, solo ganas de celebrar 💖 Drag Brunch de Reinas is for the tías who love a good mimosa, the friend group ready to scream for their favorite queen, and anyone who just wants a Saturday morning full of joy. Come early for VIP and actually meet the queens face to face, stay for a show that turns brunch into a full celebration, snap your photos after, and let the day party carry you into the afternoon. Todos son bienvenidos aquí — no hay un solo tipo de invitada perfecta, solo corazón y ganas de pasarla bien. Bring your people, pack the room, and let's make this Saturday one for the books. 🫶🏽👑

Here's the full rundown, la agenda completa para tu Saturday 📋 Drag Brunch de Reinas lands Saturday, August 8th with doors at 9:30am. Cuatro reinas, mimosas sin parar, y una tarde entera para disfrutar en grande. Tickets range $15-$50 depending on your experience — reserve your table now porque esto se llena rápido. No excuses, no llegar tarde — this is the brunch Pasco's been waiting for. 🎟️🥂
